cover.quote: 92% increase in Mineral Resources from 55.4 Mt to 106.6 Mt at 4.12% Total Rare Earth Oxide (TREO) from 30 June 2018 to 30 June 20241.

statement.quote: The Mt Weld Rare Earth Mineral Resources estimate is now 106.6 million tonnes at an average grade of 4.12% Total Rare Earth Oxide (TREO) for a total of 4.39 million tonnes of contained TREO. A Mineral Resource cut-off grade of 2.5% TREO was applied.

cutoff_footnote.quote: 1 Mineral Resource cut-off grade of 2.5% TREO applied
